big_story.headline: Stumbling Over Scotch
big_story.subhead: INDIA-UK TRADE DEAL HITS A SNAG AS BULK LIQUOR TARIFF DISPUTE PROMPTS GOVT TALKS
paragraphs: Negotiations for the proposed India-UK trade deal have encountered a major roadblock over import tariffs on Scotch whisky. The Indian government has called domestic and foreign liquor giants for talks to resolve the contentious issue. Domestic firms have joined foreign peers in opposing specific tariff rulings, threatening the momentum of the pact.

The dispute centres around duty structures on bulk Scotch shipments entering the country. While global distillers seek lower tariffs to access India's expanding consumer market, domestic manufacturers are raising concerns over fair competition and market protection. This standoff presents a critical test for trade negotiators attempting to finalize the bilateral agreement.

As government officials convene meetings with industry stakeholders, market observers are watching closely to see if a compromise can be struck. A resolution on liquor tariffs could clear the path for signing the trade agreement, while persistent friction risks delaying broader economic cooperation between India and the UK.
big_story.pullbox: The Scotch tariff row highlights the delicate balance between domestic market protection and bilateral trade concessions in high-stakes negotiations.

explains.title: What is a Tariff Barrier?
paragraphs: A tariff barrier is a tax or duty imposed by a government on imported goods to make foreign products more expensive relative to domestic ones. These financial levies are traditionally used to protect local industries from overseas competition and generate government revenue.

In international trade negotiations, countries often negotiate to lower or eliminate tariffs across specific sectors. When tariffs are reduced, imported items become cheaper for consumers, but domestic producers must adapt to increased foreign competition.

Space tech startup Manastu Space has secured ₹22 crore in an ongoing funding round to accelerate its propulsion and space safety technology. The deeptech firm focuses on developing green propulsion systems and satellite safety solutions for the commercial space industry.

The fresh capital will enable the founders to advance thruster testing and scale deployment capabilities. As commercial satellite launches expand globally, Indian space startups are attracting heightened investor interest for specialized orbital technology.

story_1.headline: Indian Oil Q2 Net Profit Triples to ₹21,630 Crore
paragraphs: Indian Oil Corporation reported a robust financial performance for Q2 FY27, with net profit nearly tripling to ₹21,630 crore. The sharp gain was supported by higher refining margins and official LPG compensation payouts.
Despite the strong surge in headline profits, persistent LPG risks remain a key consideration for the state-run refiner amidst volatile global energy conditions.

story_2.headline: Gold Drops Below $3,900/oz Amid Global Market Selloff
paragraphs: International gold prices broke below the $3,900 per ounce threshold amid a wider selloff across global markets. Concerns over high US interest rates and liquidity pressures led traders to liquidate safe-haven positions.
The precious metal extended its October decline, reflecting elevated market anxiety as persistent oil price volatility continues to complicate global monetary outlooks.

story_3.headline: RBI Projects 6.7% GDP Growth for FY27
paragraphs: The Reserve Bank of India projects India's economy to grow at 6.7% in FY27, anchored by strong domestic demand and manufacturing activity. Resilience in internal consumption is expected to keep growth steady despite external economic headwinds.

geopolitics.headline: India-US Trade Deal Reaches Finish Line
paragraphs: US envoy Sergio Gor announced that the proposed India-US trade deal is nearing completion, expressing determination to push the pact across the finish line ahead of the G20 summit. Highlighting surging bilateral defense ties, Gor hinted at exciting outcomes from the ongoing talks. Meanwhile, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that the deal will protect Indian farmers' interests.

Despite diplomatic momentum, potential political shifts in the upcoming US midterms could impact Congress, H-1B visas, and trade policy. Navigating agricultural protections while expanding bilateral commercial opportunities remains a central priority for negotiators. For market observers, the final terms will signal the trajectory of long-term strategic and economic alignment.

big_story.headline: CDSL Q2 Consolidated Net Profit Rises 24% to Rs 174 Crore
big_story.text: Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) reported a 24% rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 174 crore for the second quarter, alongside a 23.5% increase in revenue. The strong financial performance reflects robust market activity and retail investor growth across India. This underscores the steady expansion of the nation's capital market infrastructure.

big_story.headline: Former RBI Governor C Rangarajan Urges Building Strategic Oil Reserves
big_story.text: Former Reserve Bank of India Governor C Rangarajan stated that India must recalibrate its development strategy and build strategic oil reserves. He highlighted the necessity of shielding the domestic economy from international energy price fluctuations. Strengthening energy reserves is critical for safeguarding India's long-term macroeconomic stability against global trade shocks.

venture_vault.headline: Hardware AI Startup CopperPilot Secures $390,000 in Funding
venture_vault.text: Electronics hardware AI design agent startup CopperPilot raised $390,000 in its latest funding round. The company focuses on developing AI tools to streamline circuit board engineering and hardware innovation. This deal highlights investor confidence in Indian deeptech startups offering specialized automation products for global technology sectors.

venture_vault.headline: Deeptech Startup Viridian Ingni Raises Rs 1.47 Crore from IPV
venture_vault.text: IIT Madras-incubated deeptech startup Viridian Ingni Propulsion raised Rs 1.47 crore in funding from Inflection Point Ventures (IPV). The company develops innovative propulsion systems to support space hardware and satellite operations. The funding underscores rising private investment in India's emerging commercial spacetech ecosystem.
